preconditions.description: The number of votes is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The length of each vote is between 1 and 26 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(vote) == len(votes[0]) for vote in votes)
preconditions.description: All votes have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(vote[i] in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for vote in votes for i in range(len(vote)))
preconditions.description: Each character in the votes is an uppercase English letter.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(vote)) == len(vote) for vote in votes)
preconditions.description: All characters in each vote are unique.

preconditions.expression: all(set(votes[0]) == set(vote) for vote in votes)
preconditions.description: All teams that occur in the first vote also occur in every other vote.

postconditions.description: The length of the returned string is equal to the length of each vote.

postconditions.expression: all(char in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each character in the returned string is an uppercase English letter.
All characters in the returned string are unique.
The set of characters in the returned string is the same as the set of characters in the first vote.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] <= return_value[j] for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(i + 1, len(return_value)) if all(vote[i] > vote[j] for vote in votes))
postconditions.description: The returned string is sorted according to the ranking system described, resolving ties by subsequent positions and alphabetically if necessary.
